items.difficulty_reason: 9 行、Koszul 与 Čech 复形在模 I 下的同构检测：两种情形都化为 K -> K⊗_R S 的拟同构；由 neighbourhood-isomorphism 引理 + R→S 平坦，只要 K 的同调群都是 I-幂挠即成立；Koszul 复形的同调 I-幂挠由 homotopy-koszul 引理、扩张交错 Čech 复形的由 extended-alternating-torsion 引理给出。承重全在 span 内；3 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-map-identifies-koszul-and-cech-complexes (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 24362-24381

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reformulation of both claims as quasi-isomorphism of K with K tensor S for a complex of R-modules, the reduction to I-power torsion homology via the neighbourhood-isomorphism lemma and flatness, and the verification of I-power torsion homology for the Koszul complex and the extended alternating Cech complex by their respective lemmas (source lines 24383-24391)
